tree: For financial institutions, mortgage approval is one of the slowest and most risk-sensitive processes. Collecting fragmented data takes weeks. The delay slows growth, raises operating costs, and keeps customers waiting for approval. It also exposes banks to compliance errors.

H Company automates the entire verification flow, from retrieving third-party data to cross-checking payroll and credit information, so analysts receive complete, verified files in hours instead of weeks.
